title: Computational and Statistical Guarantees of the c-Rectified flow
abstract: arXiv:2608.02487v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recently, rectified flow has emerged as a fundamental framework for large-scale image generation, powering state-of-the-art systems such as FLUX.1 and Stable Diffusion 3. Despite its remarkable empirical success, the computational and statistical guarantees of iterative rectified flow have remained largely unexplored. We address this problem by studying c-rectified flow, a cost-aware class of rectified flow that projects velocity fields onto a gradient class while preserving endpoint marginals. The ordinary rectified flow can fail to recover the optimal transport coupling: in a Gaussian case study, the iteration converges to the optimal coupling if and only if the source and target covariance matrices commute. More generally, for a Gaussian to log-concave coupling, the ordinary rectified flow can reach a fixed point after one step from independent initialization. translated_title: c-校正流的计算与统计保证
translated_abstract: 近年来，校正流（rectified flow）已成为大规模图像生成的基础框架，支撑着FLUX.1和Stable Diffusion 3等最先进的系统。尽管其在实践中取得了显著成功，但迭代校正流的计算与统计保证在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们通过研究c-校正流来解决这一问题，这是一类代价感知的校正流，它在保持端点边缘分布的同时，将速度场投影到一个梯度类上。普通校正流可能无法恢复最优传输耦合：在一个高斯案例研究中，当且仅当源分布与目标分布的协方差矩阵可交换时，迭代才会收敛到最优耦合。更一般地，对于从高斯分布到对数凹分布的耦合，普通校正流从独立初始化出发一步之后即可达到不动点。相比之下，在适当的正则性与一致可积性假设下（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出代价感知的c-校正流，克服了普通校正流可能无法收敛到最优传输耦合（如高斯情形下协方差矩阵不可交换时失效）的缺陷，并为迭代校正流首次提供了计算复杂度与统计误差方面的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces c-rectified flow, a cost-aware variant that overcomes the failure of ordinary rectified flow to recover optimal transport couplings (e.g., when Gaussian covariance matrices do not commute), providing the first computational and statistical guarantees for iterative rectified flow.
